run_id.description:
Identifier of the test run to finalize. Accepts either:
- A **domain UUID** (e.g. `a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef0123456789`) — used by directly-dispatched ad-hoc runs
  where `VUHIVE_RUN_ID` is set to the internal TestRun UUID.
- A **Kubernetes Job name** (e.g. `vuhive-sched-abc-28492020`) — used by CronJob-spawned runner pods
  where `VUHIVE_RUN_ID` resolves to `metadata.labels['batch.kubernetes.io/job-name']`.
  The control plane will first attempt UUID lookup, then fall back to `k8s_job_name` correlation.

info.description:
Cloud-native orchestration engine for distributed high-throughput load testing workloads on Kubernetes.
Provides APIs for test suite compilation, runner profiles, scheduled execution (CronJobs),
ad-hoc execution, start barrier synchronization, and historical telemetry / report query.

All endpoints support Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) and respond to HTTP OPTIONS preflight
requests with HTTP 204 No Content, allowing web browsers and tools like Swagger UI to explore and
interact with the API across different domains and ports.

post.description:
Stops and cancels an active (QUEUED or RUNNING) test run on demand.
Deletes the underlying Kubernetes batch/v1 Job and terminates associated runner pods
with SIGTERM signal propagation, allowing the runner wrapper to flush partial execution
logs before pod eviction. Transitions the aggregate state to ABORTED and records audit metadata.
Rejects abort requests on already finalized runs with 409 Conflict.

post.description:
Accepts a multipart/form-data payload containing the Go test source archive
(`.tar.gz`) and triggers an ephemeral Kubernetes `batch/v1` Job to compile it
for the requested target platform. The response is returned immediately; the
build runs asynchronously.

**Pre-Build AST Static Analysis & Framework Enforcement**:
Uploaded archives undergo strict automated static verification before compilation:
- **Direct Dependency Check**: `go.mod` must declare `github.com/morphy76/vuhive` as a direct dependency.
- **Inverted Control Driver**: Source code must declare `package scenario` (defining a valid `vuhive.Scenario` entrypoint such as `NewScenario()`, `Scenario()`, `InitScenario()`, or `Register(*vuhive.Engine)`). Defining `package main` or `func main()` is prohibited; the platform injects a trusted `main.go` execution driver.
- **Package Import Blocklist**: Dangerous packages (`os/exec`, `syscall`, `unsafe`, `plugin`, `runtime/cgo`, `golang.org/x/sys`) are blocked by default. Callers may request an override with `allow_insecure_imports=true` if enabled by cluster administrator policy.

**Retry semantics**: If a previous compilation attempt for the same suite and
platform resulted in a `FAILED` artifact, uploading corrected sources via this
endpoint automatically resets the artifact from `FAILED → PENDING` and prunes
the stale Kubernetes Job before dispatching a fresh one. No manual database or
cluster intervention is required — just re-upload and the control plane handles
the rest.

parameters.description: Test Suite ID
parameters.name: id

allow_insecure_imports.description: Optional override to allow suspicious packages (e.g., syscall, unsafe) if permitted by cluster deployment policy

400.description: Pre-build static analysis or validation failure (missing vuhive dependency, forbidden import, illegal package main, missing scenario contract, or invalid archive)

403.description: Import blocklist override forbidden by cluster policy

post.summary: Upload Go test source and trigger build Job
